name: Clock Tower Square
summary: Clock Tower Square is Portsmouth, Rhode Island's neighborhood shopping destination, offering a convenient mix of retail shops, dining options, and medical and office facilities. Serving the East Bay community, this well-established center provides local residents with quality goods and services in a welcoming, accessible environment.
demographics: Clock Tower Square serves the affluent Portsmouth and East Bay Rhode Island communities, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals with household incomes typically exceeding $80,000. The primary trade area includes Portsmouth, Middletown, and Tiverton residents, with a strong mix of established families, retirees, and young professionals who value convenience and quality. Shoppers tend to be educated, health-conscious consumers seeking a combination of retail, dining, and professional services in a convenient neighborhood setting.
description: Clock Tower Square stands as Portsmouth's premier shopping destination, serving the East Bay Rhode Island community with a carefully curated mix of retail shops, dining establishments, and professional medical and office spaces. Located at 1 Clock Tower Square Road in Portsmouth, this community-oriented center has established itself as a convenient hub for local residents seeking quality goods and services close to home. The center's distinctive clock tower serves as a landmark for the area, symbolizing its role as a gathering place for the community. With its thoughtfully planned layout combining shopping, dining, medical facilities, and office space, Clock Tower Square offers a comprehensive destination that meets the diverse needs of Portsmouth families and professionals. The center maintains an active connection with the community through regular events and a commitment to providing a welcoming environment where neighbors can shop, dine, and conduct business in a convenient, accessible location.
